name: Family
overview: Scripture reveals the divine institution of family beginning with the creation of woman from man, establishing the profound unity of husband and wife as one flesh (Genesis 2:23-24). The family is marked by God-ordained roles and responsibilities, including the husband's leadership and the wife's submission, as part of God's design following the Fall (Genesis 3:16). The patriarch Abraham exemplifies faithfulness within the family as God promises to bless his descendants and establishes worship through altars, underscoring the family's role in honoring the Lord (Genesis 12:7-8, 13:3). These passages emphasize the family's foundation in covenant relationship, worship, and mutual commitment under God's sovereign guidance.
